entities.summary: Adam Otto Wilhelm Freiherr von Bistram, also known as Adam Ivanovich Bistrom was a commander in the Imperial Russian Army during the Napoleonic Wars. He was from a Baltic German noble family and his elder brother Karl von Bistram also fought in these wars.
